author: Kusha N M
raw:
ನಿಂದಿಸುವ ಜನ ನಿನ್ನ ಗುರುವೆಂದು ಪರಿಗಣಿಸು
ಮುಂದೆ ನಿನ ಗುರಿಗವರೆ ಶಕ್ತಿ ತುಂಬುವರು
ಹಿಂದಾಡೊ ಜನಗಳನು ಲೆಕ್ಕಕ್ಕೆ ಇರಿಸದೆಯೆ
ಮುಂದಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಯಿಡು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Count those who criticise you as your teachers;
they are the ones who will strengthen you toward your goal;
pay no heed to those who talk behind your back,
and keep stepping forward, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Honest critics sharpen us and help us reach our goals. Backbiters are not worth attention; keep moving forward.
